mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that directly boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold requirements.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE is below 5.0% for two consecutive months, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates accommodative monetary policy supporting economic expansion, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and INDPRO rise produces Rank IC < 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% sustained for 3 months), a rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals persistent inflation that triggers further rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 3 months), S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases despite rising CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer confidence and construction activity that directly supports economic growth and corporate revenue, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold requirements.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 1.0% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed the 12-month moving average by more than 1.5%, it signals strong consumer spending that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS exceeds the 12-month moving average by > 1.5%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates synchronized demand for consumer goods and capital goods, accelerating economic growth and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and INDPRO increase produces Rank IC < 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shocks (INDPRO falling below 95.0% of its 12-month average for two consecutive months), a decline in industrial production signals reduced manufacturing output that depresses corporate profits, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply shock periods (INDPRO < 95% of 12-month average for 2 months), S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
